exposure: Misoprostol vaginal insert for labor induction
outcome: Time from drug administration to delivery
cohort: 74 obese pregnant women (BMI >30 kg/m2) who underwent labor induction with misoprostol vaginal insert at 'Filantropia' Clinical Hospital, Bucharest, Romania, from June 2017 to September 2019
finding: Misoprostol vaginal insert appears to be an effective labor induction agent in obese women with high-risk pregnancies, demonstrating good maternal outcomes and low perinatal complications.
